messages.body:
Hi Elena,

We have a brand film coming up in Milan and I would like Lume to look after location and production services. It is two shooting days on 6 and 7 October, with a UK crew of 14, and we need a properly raw industrial space: exposed brick or concrete, high ceilings, plenty of daylight and room to build.

The brief is attached with everything we need priced. Could you come back with a recommendation for the space and a quote by Friday 28 August? Happy to jump on a call if anything is unclear.

Best,
Oliver

Oliver Marsh
Head of Production, Harlow & Pine
14 Clerkenwell Green, London EC1R 0DP

messages.subject: Aurelia Moda autumn lookbook - brief
messages.body:
Dear Elena,

thank you for taking my call on Friday. As promised, here is the brief for our autumn lookbook.

We plan two shooting days in the last week of September, ideally Thursday 24 and Friday 25. We need a villa with proper gardens and a good choice of interiors: a couple of salons, a staircase, one or two bedrooms with natural light. The mood is warm, earthy, a little theatrical. We have around 36 looks in total, two models, and a team of about 25 on set including our creative director and the photographer.

Photographer and creative team are on our side. We would like Lume to take care of the location, styling and hair and make-up support, lighting and grip, catering and logistics. The villa should be within an hour of Milan, with parking for 6 to 8 vehicles and enough power for continuous lights.

Our budget is around EUR 40,000 to 45,000 all-in. Could you come back to us with a shortlist by the end of next week?

Kind regards,
Beatrice

Beatrice Sala
Head of campaign production
Aurelia Moda
Tel. +39 02 5550 1127

messages.subject: Cyclorama studio for 2-day still life - Maison Delcourt
messages.body:
Dear Luca,

Elena suggested I write to you directly. We are preparing the still life images for our autumn fragrance launch and I am looking for a studio in Milan with a cyclorama, for two shooting days in the week of 7 September (ideally Tuesday 8 and Wednesday 9).

The brief is three bottles (Nuit d'Ambre 50 ml, Figuier Blanc 100 ml and the travel set) on a mix of seamless backgrounds and a few small built sets, so the set needs to stay standing overnight between the two days. We would be a small crew: photographer, assistant, myself and one person from our creative team, so five people at most on site.

Could you also take care of the photographer? Elena mentioned Lorenzo Ricci and I loved his previous work for a perfume house. Our all-in budget for studio, photographer and assistant is around EUR 10,000, excluding retouching, which we handle in-house.

Could you send me a quote by the end of the week if possible? I need to get internal sign-off before the 20th.

Many thanks and kind regards,

Camille Roche
Content Producer | Maison Delcourt
+33 1 40 55 01 27

messages.subject: Palazzo Arconati Vela – proposal for a preferred agency partnership
messages.body:
Dear Elena,

I hope you are well and having a quieter August. I am writing because the Palazzo is reorganising how it handles requests from film and photo productions, and we would like to work with one agency as our preferred partner rather than answering a dozen different agencies each season.

Your name came up more than once after the shoot you ran with us last spring, and the care your team took with the floors and the Galleria was noticed by our heritage staff. We would like to propose that Lume Locations becomes our preferred agency for shoots at the palazzo, under a simple written agreement. I would prefer to explain the details in person and show you the rooms we are now making available.

Would you and one of your scouts be free to visit in the next two weeks?

Kind regards,

Silvia Pellegrini
Events and Heritage Manager
Palazzo Arconati Vela
Tel. +39 02 5550 1142
silvia.pellegrini@palazzo-arconati.example

messages.subject: Aurelia Moda lookbook - villa shortlist
messages.body:
Hi Beatrice,

Sara here, I'm the one who will be dragging you through gardens. I found three villas that fit your brief, all free on 24 and 25 September and all within an hour of Milan.

1. Villa Carpaneda, Brianza (about 40 minutes). Italianate garden with box hedges and a long gravel avenue, a glass orangery, a salone with frescoed ceiling, a stone staircase with beautiful side light, and four bedrooms on the first floor in faded greens and ochre. Parking for 10 cars on the side court. Venue fee EUR 8,500 for two days.

2. Villa Sormani, Franciacorta (about 55 minutes). Grand and formal, with a terraced garden over the vineyards and two large salons. Fewer bedrooms, and the interiors are darker. Venue fee EUR 11,000 for two days.

3. Villa Rovagnati, Lecco side (about 50 minutes). Smaller and more intimate, with a walled garden and a lovely kitchen, but only one real salon and a tight staircase for a 25-person crew. Venue fee EUR 7,200 for two days.

My honest favourite is Carpaneda. The orangery in late September will look incredible with your colour palette. I'm attaching nothing for now, but I can send you the full photo sets today if you like, and we can organise a visit with your creative director.

Sara

Sara Moretti

messages.subject: Arconati Vela visit – rooms and rates
messages.body:
Ciao Elena,

I loved today, honestly. I have written up the rooms and the rate list Silvia gave us, and the PDF is attached. The short version: the Salone d'Onore and the Galleria are the stars (3,800 and 3,200 per day), but the Limonaia at 1,700 is the real find for us. It has beautiful daylight, it is easy to get into, and nobody has used it for productions yet. Cortile fits six vehicles, which is enough for most fashion jobs.

Things to keep in mind: power is only 30 kW from the house, generators must stay in the courtyard, no haze or smoke in the Galleria, and floor protection is mandatory everywhere. Overtime after 20:00 is 250 an hour and there is a 2,000 refundable deposit. Silvia also said the heritage supervisor must be on site all day, which is charged separately.

I took about 200 photos and will put them in the shared folder tomorrow morning.

Sara

LUME LOCATIONS – FREELANCE PRODUCER (PEAK SEASON)
Milan, October – December 2026, possibility of extension

Who we are
Lume Locations is a location and production agency based in Milan. We find places and run the logistics for advertising, fashion and cosmetics shoots across Italy.

The role
You will produce shoot days for our clients, working with our production manager: venue liaison, permits, crew and supplier bookings, call sheets, budgets and wrap reports.

What we are looking for
- At least 3 years in production for advertising, fashion or film
- Good knowledge of Milan and Lombardy permits and venues
- Fluent Italian and professional English
- Calm under pressure, precise with numbers
- Own VAT number (partita IVA)

What we offer
Day-rate engagement, commensurate with experience, with a trial period.

Dear Elena,

The main points are a commission of 15% to Lume on the net location fees of bookings you bring to the palazzo, and a 12-month exclusivity under which the Palazzo will not grant access for film and photo shoots to other production agencies. Silvia Pellegrini

Palazzo Arconati Vela

attachments.content:
PALAZZO ARCONATI VELA - PARTNERSHIP AGREEMENT (DRAFT 1, 1 SEPTEMBER 2026)
Between Fondazione Palazzo Arconati Vela (the Palazzo) and Lume Locations S.r.l., Milan (the Agency)

Art. 1 Purpose
The Agency is appointed preferred agency for film and photo shoots at the Palazzo.

Art. 2 Exclusivity
For 12 months from signature the Palazzo will not grant location access for shoots to any other production agency or location agency. Bookings made directly by brands are excluded.

Art. 3 Commission
The Palazzo pays the Agency 15% of the net location fee (excl. VAT) of each booking originated by the Agency.

Art. 4 Rates
Rates follow the Palazzo list 2026 (Salone d'Onore EUR 3,800 per day, Galleria EUR 3,200, Limonaia EUR 1,700). Rates may be updated each January.

Art. 5 Payment
The Agency invoices commission within 30 days of the shoot. The Palazzo pays within 30 days of invoice receipt by bank transfer.

Art. 6 Conduct on site
The Agency ensures compliance with the Palazzo's heritage rules and the presence of the heritage supervisor.

Art. 7 Duration
The agreement lasts 12 months and may be renewed by written agreement.

Art. 8 Law and jurisdiction
Italian law. Courts of Milan.

The agreement takes effect on approval by the Board of the Fondazione and signature by both parties.

Between Fondazione Palazzo Arconati Vela (the Palazzo) and Lume Locations S.r.l., Milan (the Agency)

The Agency is appointed preferred agency for film and photo shoots at the Palazzo.

The Palazzo pays the Agency 15% of the net location fee (excl. VAT) of each booking originated by the Agency.

The Agency ensures compliance with the Palazzo's heritage rules and the presence of the heritage supervisor.

The agreement lasts 12 months and may be renewed by written agreement.

Italian law. Courts of Milan.

messages.body:
Hi Elena,

I recommend keeping the higher cover. Here is the comparison:

1. Expiring policy: EUR 5,400, equipment cover EUR 250,000, no drone.

The one thing I would test is the excess. It is EUR 500 per claim now and a higher one should bring the All Risks line down.

Tommaso

messages.subject: Important: updates to the VenueDesk Partner Terms from 1 October 2026
messages.body:
Dear partner,

We are updating the VenueDesk Partner Terms. The changes take effect on 1 October 2026 and apply to bookings confirmed from that date.

Summary of changes
1. Service fee: the fee deducted from venue payouts will change from 12% to 13% of the booking value (location fee, cleaning and other venue-set fees). Bookings confirmed before 1 October keep the current 12%.
2. Payout timing: payouts will be released 3 working days after the last shoot day (previously 5).
3. Cancellation policies: a new "Strict" policy option is available per listing. Existing listings keep their current policy.
4. Reviews: venues may now request removal of reviews that contain personal data or that relate to a booking that did not take place.

The full text of the Partner Terms is available here:
https://www.venuedesk.example/legal/partner-terms-2026-10

If you do not wish to continue under the updated terms you may close your account before 1 October 2026 without penalty. Continued use of the platform after that date constitutes acceptance.

Questions? Contact partner support at https://help.venuedesk.example/partners

Kind regards,
The VenueDesk Partner Team

messages.subject: Re: Lume Locations general terms – update
messages.body:
Ciao Laura,

Here are my comments on the first draft, which is a good base. On cancellation, 14 days is too long for the small productions that make up most of our work, so I would move to more than 10 days free, 10 to 4 days at 50%, and 3 days or less at 100%.

On weather I would be more flexible. If the client decides by 4 pm the day before, one postponement should be free of any fee, and a second one should cost 25% of the location fee. We lose very little when we can move the date, and clients remember it. The overtime rate in 8.3 is also wrong, it should be EUR 95 per hour.

On images, I want to keep our right to use stills for the portfolio, but the client must be able to ask in writing before the shoot for confidentiality, for example for unreleased products. We should also never publish identifiable faces of talent without their approval.

Grazie,
Elena

messages.subject: Re: Fwd: Draft agreement – Palazzo Arconati Vela / Lume Locations
messages.body:
Cara Elena,

I have reviewed the draft and my comments are in the attached note. In short, the text is balanced overall, and the 15% commission and the payment terms in Art. 5 are in line with the market.

Two points I would change before you sign. First, the exclusivity in Art. 2 is far too wide as written: it binds the Palazzo, but it also positions you as the only channel for all production work, which creates risk for you if the volume does not come. I would limit it to fashion shoots, so that the Palazzo remains free to deal with others for advertising, film and television. Second, there is no way out of the agreement. I would add a termination clause with 60 days' written notice for either party, and immediate termination for serious breach, with commission on bookings already confirmed remaining payable.

If you agree, I can send Silvia a marked-up text. Let me know how you wish to proceed.

Cordiali saluti,

Avv. Laura Bettini
Studio Legale Bettini
Via Cusani 10, Milano
Tel. +39 02 8055 3317

attachments.content:
STUDIO LEGALE BETTINI - COMMENTS ON DRAFT 1 (PALAZZO ARCONATI VELA / LUME LOCATIONS)
Date: 14 September 2026

1. Art. 2 Exclusivity
Current: 12 months, all production agencies and location agencies excluded.
Proposed: limit to fashion shoots (stills and film). The Palazzo remains free to work with other agencies for advertising, film, TV and corporate content.
Reason: avoids tying Lume to a single channel without a minimum volume commitment.

2. Art. 3 Commission
No change. 15% on net fee is in line with the market. Suggest adding: commission also due on extensions and added days agreed on site.

3. Art. 5 Payment
No change. 30 + 30 days is acceptable.

4. Art. 7 Duration - NEW termination clause
Either party may terminate with 60 days' written notice (PEC or registered letter).
Immediate termination for serious breach, including damage to the property or non-payment.
Commission on bookings confirmed before termination remains payable.

5. Art. 6 Conduct on site
Clarify that responsibility for damage is that of the production company and its insurance, not of the Agency, unless the Agency causes the damage.

6. Art. 8
No change. Courts of Milan are acceptable.

messages.subject: Luminar spend analysis – 12 months
messages.body:
Ciao Elena,

attached is the spend analysis on Luminar, with the Cinelux comparison Giulia collected. Grip & Light came back about 6% above Luminar's current rates, so I left them out.

In short: our net spend with Luminar over the last 12 months was EUR 34,860. The 8% rise would have cost us about EUR 2,790 a year, the 5% in Stefano's offer about EUR 1,740. Cinelux is roughly 2.1% cheaper than Luminar at +5%, but their EUR 800 account fee means the saving only starts above about EUR 38,000 of yearly spend. At our current volume it is basically a wash, a little negative once you add the switching effort. At +8% it would have been worth moving, saving about EUR 1,000.

The EUR 30,000 commitment is about 86% of last year's spend, so the shortfall risk looks low, unless we lose a big client. Offer is valid until 20 September.

Tommaso

LUME LOCATIONS - ANALISI SPESA NOLEGGIO ILLUMINAZIONE
Preparata da Tommaso Rinaldi - 15/09/2026

Q4 2025 (ott-dic)          9.420
Q1 2026 (gen-mar)          6.180

Q3 2026 (lug-ago)          9.000
Totale 12 mesi            34.860

Impatto aumento su base annua
Aumento 8%:  34.860 x 8% = 2.789

Quota account annua Cinelux: 800

Contro Luminar +8% (37.650): risparmio lordo 1.811 - quota 800 = +1.011

messages.subject: Nordlicht winter campaign - three location options
messages.body:
Hi Jonas, hi Anke,

I'm Sara, the location scout at Lume. I read the brief twice and went through my November list. I have three places that I think suit the Eisblume look, and the short summary is attached.

1. Casa Ortelli, a lake house about 75 minutes from Milan. It is a private house that is nearly empty in off-season, with a stone jetty, a long terrace facing the water and a wood-panelled living room with a big fireplace. In November the morning mist on the lake is beautiful. This is my favourite for your brief.

2. Palazzo Arconati Vela, on the northern edge of Milan. It has frosted formal gardens, a long gallery with soft north light and a few warm salons. There is no water apart from the fountains, but it is easy to reach and good for the film.

3. Cascina Rovelli, a restored farmhouse in the lowland countryside. It has open fields with frost in the early morning, a barn with an interior and a warm kitchen. It is the simplest option logistically and the one with the lowest costs.

I can arrange a recce of any of them in the week of 5 October. Let me know which ones you would like to see first, and I will start on availability and rates.

Sara

Sara Moretti
Location Scout
Lume Locations, Milan

messages.subject: Re: Fwd: Ex Officine Brenta shoot 6–7 October – quote and contract
messages.body:
Cara Elena,

I have read the contract. It is clear and balanced overall, and Italian law with the Milan courts is fine for an English-language agreement. I would make two edits.

1. Clauses 8.1 to 8.3: "days" is not defined and could be read as working days. Please write "calendar days" in all three, and add that notice of cancellation must be given in writing by email to the addresses in clause 12.

2. Clause 9.2: as written you would refund all sums received, including amounts already paid to third parties such as the venue, the generator hire and the set builder. I suggest: "If such an event prevents the shoot, either party may terminate and Lume shall refund the sums received less documented, non-recoverable costs already committed to third parties and the portion of the Fee corresponding to work already performed." In 9.1 I would also add, as examples of events beyond control, the closure or withdrawal of the Location by its owner and any order or refusal of a public authority not caused by Lume.

With these changes you are well covered. Send me the revised version if you would like me to look at it once more before it goes out.

Un caro saluto,
Laura

Avv. Laura Bettini
Studio Legale Bettini
Via Manzoni 31, Milano
T +39 02 7600 5512

LUME LOCATIONS SRL – GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS
Final version – 17 September 2026 (applies to quotes issued from 1 October 2026)

7. CANCELLATION BY THE CLIENT
7.1 Cancellation more than 10 days before the first shoot day: no charge, except non-refundable deposits paid to third parties.
7.2 Cancellation between 10 and 4 days before: 50% of Lume's service fee.
7.3 Cancellation 3 days or less before: 100% of Lume's service fee.
7.4 All cancellations must be notified in writing. The notice period runs from the date the email is received.

8. WEATHER AND DELAYS
8.1 Where the shoot is planned outdoors, weather is a risk borne by the client.
8.2 If the client decides by 4 pm on the day before the shoot to postpone because of weather, one postponement is free of any fee.
8.3 A second postponement is charged at 25% of the location fee.
8.4 Free postponement applies only if the location is available on the new date.
8.5 Overtime caused by delays on set is invoiced at EUR 95 per hour per member of Lume staff.

9. USE OF IMAGES
9.1 The client holds the rights to the final material produced for the client.
9.2 Lume may use stills and behind-the-scenes images of the location for promotion and for its portfolio, without time limit.
9.3 Lume will not publish identifiable images of talent without their approval.
9.4 The client may request confidentiality in writing (e.g. unreleased products).
9.5 Confidentiality requests must be received before the first shoot day.

attachments.content:
Aurelia Moda – Spring 2026 campaign at Villa Carpaneda
Submitted by Lume Locations, Milan. Category: Fashion & Beauty.

Brief. Aurelia Moda asked for a spring campaign that felt lived-in rather than staged: soft morning light, real textures, nothing that looked like a set. The brand's in-house production team needed one location able to hold six looks, a short film and stills over two days, on a tight budget and a fixed calendar tied to the collection launch.

Choice. After scouting seven properties, we proposed Villa Carpaneda, an eighteenth-century country villa with a walled garden, a loggia, a faded frescoed salon and a lemon house. Our scout, Sara Moretti, saw that it offered what the brief needed: five distinct settings within a two-minute walk of each other, which meant fewer unit moves and more shooting time.

Delivery. The estate is a working property, so the main challenge was coexistence. With the estate manager, Alberto Cattaneo, we agreed a floor-protection plan, limited the crew to 38 people, kept all vehicles outside the gravel court and scheduled the frescoed salon for the afternoon, when the light is steadiest.

Result. Both days finished on schedule, with half a day in hand that allowed an unplanned sequence in the loggia at dusk. The villa was handed back exactly as found. The campaign launched in April across print, digital and in-store, with a loggia image as the lead visual.

Why it deserves the prize. The location was not a backdrop but a creative partner: the brief, the architecture and the production plan were shaped together from the first scouting day. We believe it shows what a location agency can do when it is involved early.

Photography: Lorenzo Ricci. Client: Aurelia Moda, Spring 2026 campaign.

messages.subject: Winter campaign - two location options for 5 November
messages.body:
Dear Camille,

I am Sara, the location scout at Lume. Elena asked me to send you two options for the winter shoot, with photos in the attached sheet.

Cascina Rovelli (Lombardy plain, near Lodi): a working farmhouse with a large brick and stone courtyard, a long porticoed barn and open fields with poplars. In November the morning fog is very reliable. Inside there is a farmhouse kitchen with a wood stove, ideal for the warm interior shots.

Casa Ortelli (Lake Como, east shore): a stone lake house with a hall and big fireplace, a small walled garden with bare fruit trees and a stone jetty. Cold and quiet in winter, with soft grey light off the water.

Both could work for one day with a small crew and both have parking for a couple of vans. I am checking availability for Thursday 5 November with both owners this morning and will tell you as soon as I have an answer. Happy to arrange a recce or a video walk-through if useful.

Best regards,
Sara Moretti

attachments.content:
LUME LOCATIONS - INCIDENT REPORT
Location: Terrazza Dodici, Via Tortona 12, Milano
Shoot: Corvo Studio, 3 September 2026 (call 08:00, wrap 19:30)
Report by: Giulia Bassi, production manager - written 4 September 2026

1. Handover: walkthrough on 2 Sept at 16:10 with N. Fabbri. Handover form signed, no damage noted. Glass panels not inspected one by one.
2. Set-up: two light stands with sandbags (Luminar rental) placed about 1.5 m from the east balustrade from 09:30. No equipment was fixed to or leaning on the glass.
3. Wrap: derig started at 18:30. Crew on terrace: G. Bassi, S. Moretti, L. Fontana, 9 client and crew staff.
4. At 18:50 S. Moretti noticed a crack of about 40 cm rising from the lower corner of panel no. 4 (east side). Nobody saw any impact or heard a noise.
5. Photos taken at 18:55 (14 images). Area cordoned off with tape. Venue night staff informed at 19:10.
6. Equipment checked: no stand or case near panel no. 4 was moved or knocked during derig, according to the crew.
7. 4 Sept, 09:20: G. Bassi informed N. Fabbri by phone. No liability discussed.
8. 4 Sept: E. Conti called F. Marchetti (Garante Assicurazioni) by phone to inform him.

Witnesses available: S. Moretti, L. Fontana, M. Ferraro (Corvo Studio).

messages.subject: Nordlicht invoice LL-2026-0147: PO number, how to correct
messages.body:
Ciao Elena,

Nordlicht's accounts payable have rejected invoice LL-2026-0147 (EUR 28,500.00 plus VAT, EUR 34,770.00 total) because it has no PO number. Anke sent PO 4500731926 on Thursday and asked for a corrected invoice.

The invoice has already gone through the SdI, so I cannot just add the number. I can either re-issue it with the PO, which means a new number and date, or issue a credit note for the full amount against LL-2026-0147 and send a separate new invoice. I would go for the credit note plus new invoice, because the first invoice is already registered and a credit note keeps the paper trail clean for their auditors. Which do you prefer?

Either way the 30 days start again from the new invoice date, so the due date moves from 15 October to 18 October at the earliest, and Anke counts from receipt of the valid invoice. I would send the new one today once you confirm.

Tommaso

messages.subject: Casa Ortelli - 18 November availability and rates
messages.body:
Ciao Paola,

I hope you are well. I'm writing from Lume Locations about a possible shoot at the house for a German cosmetics brand. They love the jetty, the terrace and the living room with the fireplace.

The shoot day would be Wednesday 18 November, with Thursday 19 November as a backup. We would like to come the afternoon before to prepare, so 17 November too if possible. About 22 people in total, 2 models, stills and a short film, no overnight stay. We would need the exterior, the terrace, the jetty and the living room.

Could you tell me:
1. whether those dates are free
2. your day-rate for off-season, and the rate for the prep day
3. whether heating, electricity and cleaning are included
4. whether you ask for a deposit at booking
5. how many vehicles can park on the forecourt

A rough figure is enough for now, because the client has to approve their budget. A recce in the week of 5 October would be perfect if you are at the house.

Grazie mille,
Sara

Location Scout
Lume Locations, Milan

messages.subject: Harlow & Pine hotel – 13 rooms for 14 people, need your call
messages.body:
Ciao Elena,

I need a decision from you on the Harlow & Pine hotel. Priya increased the crew from 12 to 14 on Tuesday, but Anna at Borgo Lambro can only give us 13 rooms for 4 to 8 October (a trade fair that week). Her option expires Sunday at 12:00, and she would like our answer today if possible.

The two options:
1. Split the crew: 13 rooms at Borgo Lambro (EUR 8,840 with city tax) plus one room in a second hotel nearby. I haven't contacted anyone yet, but a comparable room for 4 nights would probably be EUR 600 to 700. Total stays under their EUR 9,600 budget, but the crew is split and the 05:30 call on the 6th is a bit more awkward.
2. Ask Oliver to cut one person, so 13 people fit in the 13 rooms. Everyone stays together, but it means going back to the client after they just added two people.

The extra two are the DIT and a camera trainee, if that helps you decide. Which way do you want to go? I can reply to Anna and Priya as soon as I hear from you.

Giulia
